  fun v hv i j => hv (i - j)

have hneg : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℤ, (∀ i j, X i j = 1 ∨ X i j = -1) → ∀ i j, (-X) i j = 1 ∨ (-X) i j = -1 :=
  by
  intro X hX i j
  rw [Matrix.neg_apply]
  rcases hX i j with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> simp
